$comment: Not a description of the values - values.yaml is that. Only what a value must never be. auth._drawnSessionSecret and valkey._drawnPassword are where kubetower.sessionSecret and kubetower.valkeyPassword remember what they drew for the rest of one render; set from outside, the first would skip the 32-character check and the second would put a password of the user's choosing - an empty one included - in place of the one already in the cluster. Helm validates this before rendering, so the chart's own writes are never refused.
